_comment: Shared transport-policy host vectors -- the single source of truth for the loopback contract. Consumed by the Python drift guard (tests/test_transport.py) and the Pi plugin's Vitest drift guard (integrations/pi/plugins/powercontext/tests/transport-policy.spec.ts). Every entry is a valid URL authority so both languages can build http://<host>:8000: loopback hosts must be trusted for plaintext, non_loopback hosts must be refused plaintext. Keep this aligned with src/powercontext/transport.py.
